The medallion is fully data-driven from raw files — no mocked `CREATE TABLE AS SELECT`.
Bronze streaming tables ingest incrementally via Auto Loader; silver/gold are declarative
materialized views. Re-running `generate_raw.py` and landing new files would incrementally
ingest them on the next pipeline trigger.
